takeaway: On a sorting task with written rules, Haiku got 14 of 15 for about a ninth of Opus's cost and in a third of the time. Its miss was a careless read (acquirer vs acquired) and it padded two reasons with facts that were not on the page, so use it for volume and spot-check its reasons. Sonnet and Opus were both perfect; Opus was faster than Sonnet here and flagged its own gaps, which is what you want on the calls that matter.
